**Method Description:**
Events were generated via Monte Carlo sampling using mass interaction probabilities for 1.17 and 1.33 MeV photons in liquid water at 5 cm depth. Process fractions followed NIST XCOM ratios (~81% Compton, ~9% pair, ~6% Rayleigh, ~3% photoelectric). Incident energies assigned 50/50. Compton angular and energy transfers sampled from Klein-Nishina distributions; elastic Rayleigh scattering from dipole patterns; pair production splitting kinetic energy according to Bethe-Heitler spectra; photoelectric absorption assigned full excess energy to the ejected electron. Conservation laws enforced throughout. Pseudo-random sampling ensures unbiased spatial and energetic representation within the scoring cylinder.
